Name: Objection's Adoptable Australian Shepherds
Author: Objection777
Description:
Adds a mini Australian Shepherd as an additional starting pet, or purchasable later for 40,000g.


I don't think I plan to do variants, may add bandanas later, we shall see.

Let me know if this doesn't work for some reason, this is my first completed mod and I'm pretty sure this is good to go as it is.


[spoiler]This is a tribute to my recently departed dog and bestest buddy, Toby, AKA Tobinator, Tobert, and Tobington.
I hope you enjoy the mod![/spoiler]
